cases.name: Ashley Taylor Brown
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Ashley embraced life with her wild spirit and a heart overflowing with love. Her siblings, Aaron Barnshaw, Alex Amyx, Jory Barnshaw and Sophia and Kaitlyn Borden, will forever cherish her memory. She shared a uniquely beautiful bond with her adoptive mother, Connie Brown. After Connie's recent passing, Ashley's maternal instincts to protect her son, Zabe Mendez, intensified because she wanted his childhood to be full of people who loved him. Ashley and Robby Mendez welcomed Zabe two years ago, and she instantly blossomed as his mom. Together Robby and Ashley co-parented with love and dedication to Zabe. Robby will continue to nurture Zabe and work to fulfill Ashley's dreams for him. Ashley's heart extended beyond her family and friends. As a Rainbow Girl she created hygiene packets for girls in shelters. Her love for animals led to her volunteer work at the Helping Hands Humane Society and the Topeka Cat Association. She was a dedicated employee at the City of Topeka and a local car dealership.

Ashley approached life with passion, whether it was her fitness goals, her dedication to her friends, or the way she nurtured her siblings."
